rule.description: In the per-destination output plugin implementation packages (plugin/<destination>/src), a function that resolves a destination name (topic, queue, exchange, routing key, index, database, collection, cache key) from a {$} configuration template through the shared plugin/driver TransfeResult primitive and then scrubs the resolved name with its own inline character-handling code (strings.Map, strings.NewReplacer, strings.Replace/ReplaceAll, regexp.MustCompile with ReplaceAllString/ReplaceAll on a *regexp.Regexp, index-with-character-literal assignment, or a loop building a scrubbed buffer by appending character literals), so the per-destination name policy must be re-implemented and re-edited inside every destination plugin instead of being declared in one shared place.

checks.description: Detect destination-plugin functions that resolve a destination name with the shared plugin/driver TransfeResult {$} template primitive and scrub the resolved name with inline character-handling code of their own instead of declaring their name policy through one shared mechanism in the shared plugin/driver package.
checks.detected_relation: destination plugin function -> inline copy of the per-destination name policy applied to a template-resolved destination name
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Each destination output plugin keeps its own copy of the same conceptual name-handling policy (resolve from {$} template, then replace invalid characters, clamp length, and fall back when the resolved name is empty). A single conceptual change to that policy - a new character rule, a new length limit, a new empty-name fallback, a new destination kind - requires locating and re-editing one private implementation inside every plugin, which is exactly the scattered-responsibility relation the assigned smell describes.

matches.evidence: Resolves This.p.Topic through pluginDriver.TransfeResult and then rewrites the resolved topic with an inline strings.Map whitelist ([a-zA-Z0-9._-] kept, everything else replaced with '_'); called from getMsg.

Resolves exchange, routingkey and queuename through pluginDriver.TransfeResult and scrubs all three through a local filterMqName closure built on strings.NewReplacer plus a hand-rolled 255-byte clamp.

Resolves This.p.KeyConfig through driver.TransfeResult, then walks the resolved key byte by byte replacing control characters and spaces with '_', with its own empty-name fallback to SchemaName:TableName.
Resolves This.p.KeyConfig through driver.TransfeResult and scrubs it with a package-private memcacheKeyFilter regexp plus a hand-rolled 250-byte clamp.
Resolves SchemaName and TableName through pluginDriver.TransfeResult and then runs its own inline '$' replacement and empty-name fallback for both names.
Second private copy of the same MongoDB '$'-replacement and empty-name fallback logic applied to TransfeResult-resolved schema and collection names, needed on the delete path.

Resolves This.p.EsIndexName through pluginDriver.TransfeResult and scrubs the index name with strings.ToLower plus an inline strings.NewReplacer for eleven disallowed characters, plus its own empty-index fallback.

Resolves This.p.QueueName through pluginDriver.TransfeResult and scrubs the STOMP destination with an inline rune loop replacing ' ', ':', '\\', '*', newline and carriage return, plus its own Bifrost_-prefixed empty-name fallback.

excluded.reason: The shared contract package is the single place where a consolidated destination-name policy belongs (it already owns the TransfeResult primitive every plugin calls). The rule scope only covers the per-destination implementation packages plugin/<destination>/src, so the consolidated shape is never flagged.
These functions call TransfeResult to resolve {$} row values for column mapping, not destination names; they contain no name-scrubbing policy and are not part of the same relation.

excluded.target: strings.ToLower without replacement, Trim, Split, Join, Index, Contains and case conversion in destination plugins
excluded.reason: Case conversion, trimming, and searching are not character-scrubbing replacements and are deliberately outside the idiom set; only replacement-style character scrubbing of a template-resolved name indicates the duplicated name policy.
Uses strings.Replace to convert row values of type set before writing them as column data; it handles data values, not destination names resolved from templates, and does not call TransfeResult.
The rule analyzes production implementation files only; test helpers are outside the maintenance relation the case models.
